subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should an upgrade intentionally stop authorizing unresolved shipped LID-form WhatsApp allowlist entries until the operator supplies a verified phone mapping?
rationale: The patch correctly avoids unsafe same-digit PN/LID inference, but choosing fail-closed behavior changes a shipped authorization path and can block previously accepted senders; that security-versus-upgrade tradeoff requires explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept fail-closed migration
options.body: Merge after exact-head validation, accepting that verified entries migrate while unresolved or conflicting LID entries remain configured but unauthorized with doctor warnings.

options.title: Preserve authorization temporarily
options.body: Revise the upgrade design to retain legacy authorization by default and introduce a separately approved strict transition, accepting the additional compatibility code and wider authorization risk.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head validation, accepting that verified entries migrate while unresolved or conflicting LID entries remain configured but unauthorized with doctor warnings.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr has the strongest current and prior merged ownership signal across the affected WhatsApp identity and connection paths.
